name: Homerun Resources Inc.
summary: Homerun Resources Inc. identifies and develops mineral assets in Canada and Brazil, with a focus on extracting and refining silica sand. It has the exclusive right to buy the whole of the Tatooine Silica project near Brisco, British Columbia, and oversees the Belmonte silica concession in Bahia. Originally established in 1980 as EnviroTek Remediation Inc., it has its main office in Vancouver, Canada.
